title: Chapter 297: The Ancient Ye Clan
content:
Chapter 297: The Ancient Ye Clan

"who?!"

The boy's face was startled and he quickly turned his head to look.

I saw that a faint light was emitted from the broken ruins.

After careful consideration, the boy could not resist the temptation and slowly headed towards the ruins.

The faint light dissipated, and the boy suddenly realized that it was an unknown piece of metal.

Very familiar.

Wait, isn't this from that ancient shield?

When the boy was shocked, an old man, who was almost transparent, slowly emerged from the broken fragment.

"It's you!"

What a good guy, it's really that ancient shield.

"Why are you like this?"

After the shock, the boy looked puzzled and then he unconsciously took two steps back.

Seeing this, the old man sighed slowly, "I'm done."

Hearing this, the young man sneered, "Haha, I deserve it, I'll let you cheat me."

Facing the teenager's ridicule, the old man was not angry at all.

"Maybe, everything is destined."

"However, although something went wrong, the inheritance in my hands is still there."

As soon as these words came out, a light flashed in the boy's eyes.

"Inheritance? Real or false?"

The old man said expressionlessly: "Of course it's true?"

"Why am I a little unbelievable?"

"Believe it or not?"

The boy hesitated a little, "Do you want to pass on the inheritance to me?"

"Who else but you?"

juvenile:......

"I kind of feel like you're fooling me."

Hearing this, the old man sighed, "Actually, you are not my best candidate, but those who have their own missions, so the inheritance can only be given to you. I have been waiting for too long and can't wait any longer. ”

As he said that, the old man coughed a few times.

The illusory body is even more blurred.

At this time, the boy basically believed it.

It turns out that he is blessed and destined, and his inheritance is still his turn. It's really a sight.

"Senior, junior Zhao Si will definitely not let your inheritance down!"

Immediately, Zhao Si knelt down directly at the old man.

"Oh, okay, let go of your mind."

As he said that, the old man slowly leaned towards Zhao Si.

"Let your mind go? What is this?"

Why hasn't he heard about inheritance and still has to let go of his mind? Didn't he give it to him directly?

"Let your mind go, of course, for, to kill you!!"

The old man's face suddenly became ferocious.

The kind face disappeared instantly.

At this moment, he had already entered Zhao Si's body, and there was no need to disguise him.

Zhao Si's face changed drastically.

"You, are you playing tricks on me?!"

"No!!"

As Zhao Si's consciousness gradually blurred, the old man's grim smile kept ringing from Zhao Si's body.

"Hahaha, after endless years, I finally regained my life!"

"It's a pity that this body is really a bit trash."

"Zhao Si" slowly stood up and patted the dust on his body, his eyes full of disgust.

However, he had no choice.

After so many years, he relied on the secret tricks that could attract the Emperor's Tribulation to kill countless powerful geniuses who came here to find treasures, absorbed the energy from the Emperor's Tribulation, and gradually recovered some of the strength of the past.

Nowadays, it has been hard to survive to the point where you can take over others.

It is not in vain that he abandoned himself and lived on the ancient shield and became a spirit of the weapon.

I originally thought of climbing for a while, and when I was strong enough, I would take over a terrifying monster with talent.

In this way, it is probably not far from my return to the peak strength of that year.

It’s a pity that he met Lu Xue.

His secret technique exposes the other party's hidden aura to the way of heaven in a special way.

Every existence that reaches the peak of the Immortal Saint Realm will hide itself under the heavenly path, and only then will it release its breath and attract the imperial disaster.

Therefore, his secret technique led to the imperial disaster.

But what he didn't expect was that Lu Xue could also attract the imperial disaster.

You know, Lu Xuecai is at the peak of the Immortal Lord Realm.

There is no need to overcome the tribulation at the peak of the Immortal Lord Realm.

From that moment on, he knew that Lu Xue was definitely a peerless monster that was rare in ancient and modern times.

So he couldn't help it.

In the end, he failed.

He almost died tragically under the bloody mouth of the Nine-Clawed Jilong.

"Lu Xue, right? Wait for me. Since I can't get it, I will ruin you!"

"Zhao Si" smiled fiercely and then looked into the distance.

And Zhao Si did not let his name down, and he was really looking for death.

.........

Deep in the ancient battlefield.

As Lu Xue and his group gradually deepened.

The surrounding environment has also undergone changes that are visible to the naked eye.

The air was filled with countless blood-colored mists, appearing and the smell of blood kept coming to the face, which was disgusting.

The huge remains of the corpse were lying in the distance.

There are human shapes, animal shapes, but most of them are broken.

But without exception, these corpses emit an extremely terrifying aura.

Looking around, it was full of imperial corpses.

"Is this the depths of the ancient battlefield?"

"A lot of corpses have been around for so many years, and these corpses can still be preserved."

"It's hard to imagine how terrifying these corpses were during their lifetime."

The few people continued to go deeper, but couldn't stop sighing.

I don’t know how long it took, a giant sword that shook the sky was presented to the eyes of several people.

It was inserted straight on the earth, and the huge hilt of the sword seemed to pierce the sky.

Looking down, I saw several figures sitting next to the giant sword, as if they were comprehension, so that Lu Xue and others came over and didn't notice it.

"Sister Xue, what do you say?"

"Look first."

Immediately, Lu Xue took the lead and slowly leaned towards the people.

"Who?!"

One of the men exclaimed suddenly.

Suddenly, the others opened their eyes one after another, stood up and glared at Lu Xue and others.

"You are so brave. You dare to disturb us when we practice. Get out of here!"

The leader released his second level of the Immortal Emperor Realm, trying to shock Lu Xue and others.

It's a pity that it's useless.

"Tsk, this giant sword is obviously not a master, why do you want to occupy it?"

Xiao Luo said disdainfully.

Qin Feng held the long sword in his hand and said calmly: "Before I set out on the sword, I advise you to think clearly, who should get out."

Buzz —

The sword sounded slightly, and a huge aura that belonged to Qin Feng came out.

Its power seemed to be about to break through the entire sky.

"you!"

The leader couldn't help but take two steps back when facing Qin Feng's momentum.

Little did they know that it was this step of retreat that laid the foundation for their failure.

"We are people from the Ye tribe, don't go too far."

The person in charge took a deep breath and regained his face again.

They are Ye people, why are they panic?

In the entire ancient battlefield, except for the Xiao clan, they were not afraid of any force.

Unless the other party cares about the consequences, they are forced to kill them all.

But there are only a handful of people who have the ability to kill them.

Thinking of this, the leader calmed down.

"Leaf clan?"

Xiao Luo was slightly stunned when he heard the other party's words.

Upon hearing this, the leader thought that Xiao Luo and others had been suppressed by their Ye clan's name, and immediately said arrogantly: "Yes, it's Ye clan, the ancient Ye clan."

"You're scared."
